---
title: "Issue 14882 - brand font family names are quoted in CSS"
format: html
brand:
  typography:
    fonts:
      - family: Source Sans 3
        source: google
    base: Source Sans 3
    headings: Bricolage Grotesque 96pt
    monospace: M PLUS 1 Code
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureCssRegexMatches:
        - ['--bs-body-font-family:\s*"Source Sans 3"', 'font-family:\s*"Bricolage Grotesque 96pt"', '--bs-font-monospace:\s*"M PLUS 1 Code"', '--mermaid-font-family:\s*"Source Sans 3"']
        - ['font-family:\s*Source Sans 3', 'font-family:\s*Bricolage Grotesque 96pt', 'monospace:\s*M PLUS 1 Code']
---

## A heading

Body text and `inline code`.
